name: sheet
behavior: APG dialog (modal) pattern, edge-anchored (focus trapped in the panel; Tab cycles; Esc closes; focus returns to the opener on close; aria-modal=true; labelled by title, described by description). No pointer-drag dismissal — that is anatomy/drawer.json.

parts.note: per-corner rule (semantic.md §4): the radius value comes from radius-overlay and only the corners opposite the anchored edge are rounded (edge:end → start corners, edge:bottom → top corners). Logical edge names survive RTL.

anatomyNotes: Sheet is anatomy/drawer.json minus the drag `handle` part and minus the `dragging` state — the edge-anchored modal dialog without the pointer-drag enhancement. drawer.json stays normative for the shared parts; this file exists because shadcn ships `sheet` and `drawer` as separate items (sheet = side panel, drawer = vaul bottom sheet) and consumers install them by name. Salt draws the same line: SidePanel (start/end, no drag, header + title + content + close subcomponents — the source for splitting title out of header, as dialog.json does) versus Drawer (all four edges). Size binds to size-overlay-* along the dimension normal to the anchored edge, never to control-height-*.
